{
  "schema": "ikant-le-chat-bootstrap-semantic/v1",
  "slice": "C17.CHAT_BOOTSTRAP_ACCEPTANCE_DEADLINE_INTEGRITY",
  "authority": 0,
  "intent": "Make SESSION_CHAT activation causally depend on immutable source binding, content-addressed post-accept delivery, verified local materialization, live host capability and an end-to-end deadline, while preserving exact admission and end-user pending intent.",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "TARGET_INTENT_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "canonical target recognition",
        "verbatim pending intent",
        "pure-vs-substantive bootstrap intent distinction"
      ],
      "boundary": "recognition and intent binding precede repository acquisition"
    },
    {
      "id": "SOURCE_ORIENTATION_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "GitHub API-only source channel",
        "immutable source head",
        "bounded orientation capsule",
        "single source-root binding"
      ],
      "boundary": "orientation bytes are not accepted without one immutable source root"
    },
    {
      "id": "CONSENT_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "Terms digest and presentation",
        "freeze",
        "later exact standalone I ACCEPT",
        "fresh authority-zero preaccept handoff"
      ],
      "boundary": "runtime acquisition remains forbidden before exact human acceptance"
    },
    {
      "id": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER",
      "owns": [
        "observed byte-delivery bridge",
        "immutable source ref",
        "complete exact fastboot object set",
        "content-addressed loader/shard identity",
        "bounded reads/rounds",
        "transport authority zero",
        "post-consent transport fan-in"
      ],
      "boundary": "carrier location is not source identity; every allowed delivery mode must converge on the same pinned loader/shard blob identities before materialization"
    },
    {
      "id": "VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "transfer-bound materialization receipt",
        "Git blob identity",
        "safe paths",
        "private staging",
        "atomic publish",
        "reopen/readback"
      ],
      "boundary": "delivered bytes are not an executable runtime root until locally verified"
    },
    {
      "id": "LIVE_HOST_PROBE",
      "owns": [
        "Node.js 20+",
        "filesystem CRUD/append/readback/delete",
        "SHA-256",
        "clock",
        "artifact sink",
        "SESSION_CHAT capability closure"
      ],
      "boundary": "source integrity is not local capability evidence"
    },
    {
      "id": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
      "owns": [
        "bootstrap evidence digest",
        "source/root/transfer/materialization binding",
        "single-writer persisted ACTIVE commit",
        "exactly-once pending-intent terminal effect"
      ],
      "boundary": "probe success cannot promote ACTIVE without verified materialization evidence"
    },
    {
      "id": "E2E_DEADLINE",
      "owns": [
        "monotonic origin at I ACCEPT",
        "host elapsed before Node entry",
        "local runtime elapsed",
        "120000 ms fail-closed ceiling"
      ],
      "boundary": "deadline dominates transfer, local root, probe and ACTIVE commit"
    }
  ],
  "folded_semantics": {
    "PREACCEPT_HANDOFF": "CONSENT_ROOT",
    "SESSION_CHAT_CLOSURE": "LIVE_HOST_PROBE",
    "INIT_INTENT_FOLD": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "RESUME_PENDING_INTENT": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "SOURCE_HEAD_PIN": "SOURCE_ORIENTATION_ROOT + SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER",
    "WARM_CACHE_EXACT": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT + RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "RETRY_BUDGET": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + E2E_DEADLINE",
    "FIXED_SHARD_COUNT": "transport parameter, not semantic node",
    "FLEXIBLE_TRANSPORT_FAN_IN": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER; transport plurality is folded beneath one content-addressed identity gate",
    "SAME_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CONTINUATION": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT + E2E_DEADLINE + RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT; preserves original CONSENT_ROOT"
  },
  "receipts": {
    "transfer": "ikant-le-source-bound-transfer/v1",
    "materialization": "ikant-le-runtime-root-materialization/v1",
    "bootstrap_evidence": "ikant-le-chat-bootstrap-evidence/v1",
    "bootstrap": "ikant-le-bootstrap-receipt/v2",
    "transfer_v2": "ikant-le-source-bound-transfer/v2"
  },
  "deadline_ms": 120000,
  "active_predicate": [
    "accepted current Terms",
    "source-bound transfer receipt valid",
    "local materialization receipt valid and transfer-bound",
    "live host probe passed",
    "bootstrap evidence source/root/receipt bindings valid",
    "single-writer ACTIVE commit persisted/read back",
    "single-shot acceptance_event_id consumed exactly once",
    "acceptance-origin receipt validates current Terms + immutable source head + MONOTONIC I_ACCEPT observation",
    "deadline_result is DEADLINE_PASS and no sticky deadline terminal exists"
  ],
  "qualification": {
    "enduser_cases": 1000000,
    "strata": {
      "typical": 500000,
      "edge": 300000,
      "stress": 200000
    },
    "single_node_deletion_oracle_required": true,
    "blocking_survivors_required": 0,
    "every_retained_node_must_be_necessary": true,
    "flex_transport_cases": 1000000,
    "flex_transport_modes": 6,
    "max_flex_remote_reads": 40,
    "max_flex_remote_rounds": 1,
    "runtime_availability_discovery_cases": 10000000,
    "runtime_availability_qualification_cases": 1000000,
    "runtime_availability_failure_families": 76,
    "deadline_integrity_cases": 1000000,
    "deadline_integrity_independent_oracle": true,
    "deadline_integrity_multi_mutation_min": 500000,
    "activation_continuation_cases": 1000000,
    "activation_continuation_independent_oracle": true
  },
  "claim_boundary": {
    "corpus_and_contract_relative_irreducibility": true,
    "global_formal_minimality": false,
    "semantic_mutation_is_physical_connector_proof": false,
    "semantic_mutation_is_wall_clock_measurement": false,
    "runtime_receipt_validation_does_not_create_host_capability": true,
    "transport_locator_is_authority": false,
    "flex_transport_does_not_weaken_active_predicate": true,
    "degraded_is_active": false,
    "deadline_unavailable_is_deadline_exceeded": false,
    "retry_may_reset_deadline_origin": false,
    "current_main_may_replace_session_source_head": false,
    "same_epoch_recovery_may_complete_new_downstream_facts": true,
    "same_epoch_recovery_may_reset_acceptance_or_remote_history": false
  },
  "availability_state_contract": "contracts/runtime-availability-dod.json",
  "availability_classifier": "src/runtime-availability.mjs",
  "deadline_integrity_contract": "contracts/deadline-integrity.json"
}
